openings.claim: Keep surname dividers; record household-name discrepancies and update behind-desk exceptions whenever books move.
openings.discriminator: Accurate mappings and locations reduce second searches; queue congestion predicts persistent burst-period delays.
openings.probe: Track address correctness, second searches, queues and pickup times; verify claimant before handoff; count preparation and reconciliation.
openings.uncertainty: Updating during service and adequate identity verification are unverified; unchanged searches despite correct addresses defeat benefit.

openings.claim: Existing-cart arrivals may outperform alphabetic shelving; ten synthetic fast pickups challenge universal shelving superiority.
openings.discriminator: Matched cart advantage supports retention; disappearance with greater volume or book size supports selection effects.
openings.probe: Observe naturally occurring cart/shelf cohorts using existing timing paper; record volume, size and correctness; unmatched comparisons remain inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Comparable cohorts and cart capacity are unknown; routine retention is unproven. Slower retrieval, correctness loss or capacity failure defeat it.

openings.claim: Narrow slip-only variant: update on movement, retaining the previous entry until the new location is checked; preserve surname storage.
openings.discriminator: Fewer stale entries should reduce exception-related second searches; household misfiling or concentrated arrivals may sustain delays.
openings.probe: One evening: log updates, actual locations, second searches, complete pickup times and handoff errors; count all maintenance, including after-opening corrections, toward ten minutes; stop at exhaustion.
openings.uncertainty: Causality and clerk capacity are unverified; unchanged exception-related searches despite current entries defeat benefit.

lineage.reason: Narrow scope and verification sequence retained.

decision: Bounded probes only: existing evening clerk performs all handoffs; names/contact details stay behind desk; use two shelves, one cart and existing paper; preparation stays within ten clerk-minutes. Score all available pickups: at least 95% within two minutes, zero wrong-reader handoffs. Inputs are synthetic; no intervention effect is established.
